name: Ticket Stub
description: A paper ticket with a perforated stub that swings open as you pull it, breaking one perforation after another, then comes away and falls, leaving the ticket marked as used.

props.name: children
props.description: The main part of the ticket: route, time, seat.

props.name: stub
props.description: What is printed on the stub.

props.name: torn
props.description: Controlled state. Setting it to true tears the stub off with the same motion as a pull; setting it back to false puts a whole stub back.

props.name: defaultTorn
props.description: Starts with the stub already gone.

props.name: onTear
props.description: Called when the perforation has torn through.

props.name: side
props.description: Where the stub sits. Pull it away from the ticket, or along the perforation, and the tear follows the pull; let go part way and the stub hangs by what is left, ready to be pulled again.

props.name: tearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the stub, which is a button: Enter or Space tears it.

props.name: usedLabel
props.description: Text of the stamp that lands on the ticket once the stub is gone. It is also announced.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the ticket. It is 460px wide (300px with the stub at the bottom); give it an aria-label.
